nb960068241.headline: China Cuts Resettlement Subsidies to Cool Property Sector- Mingtiandi
nb960068241.summary: China's Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development will limit resettlement subsidies in cities with overheated property markets for shantytown redevelopment projects.
nb960068241.why: China's property market policies significantly impact domestic economic growth and global commodity demand.
nb960068241.why_moved: Policy tightening in China's property sector signals government efforts to control housing prices, affecting real estate and related markets.

ncfc9ca675e.headline: World Turkish contractors talk about construction
ncfc9ca675e.summary: Turkish contractors worldwide reached $366.5 billion in total project value, with $9.2 billion in contracts awarded in the first half of 2018; Russia leads with $71.8 billion in projects.
ncfc9ca675e.why: Turkish construction firms are significant players in global infrastructure markets, and their contract wins reflect economic ties and investment flows, especially in Russia.
